engines.name: splash
engines.notes: Inco Splash 1.3.2 (Apache-2.0), macOS Apple silicon only. Archive layout: one top directory `splash-1.3.2-arm64-macos26/` holding `engine/splash` (the native engine), `python/` (a bundled Python 3.13), `install/launcher.py`, `server/`, `release.json`, `LICENSE` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES`; the kernels ship precompiled, no Xcode needed. Needs an Apple M3 or newer, macOS 26.4 or newer and at least 36 GB of memory; the index has no field for that, so the Stack enforces it at admission. Verified 2026-10-18 on an M5 Max with 128 GB: 124 tokens a second on Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_M with a thinking budget of 2000 (llama-server b10797 measured 18 to 28). Its outbound behaviour (telemetry, update and model-hub checks) is not yet recorded: the Stack must run it offline (`--offline`) and CODE-PRIVACY-01 owns the record before it ships as the default.
